statement: Two visual artists, **Khushbu Patel** and **Manika K**, were invited to engage with the themes of sensation and pain, informed by insight from neuroscience. Their creations retain their artistic subjectivity and speculative imagination.

artists.name: Khushbu Patel
artists.label: Invited artist
artists.title: Diary Pages — Khushbu Patel
artists.intro: This work takes the form of a diary — not to document events, but to trace the undercurrents of experience. Page by page it moves through quiet encounters: attraction, distance, touch, introspection. Some images slip into the surreal; others carry echoes of Indian miniature painting, where scale and detail compress complex emotion into small spaces.

items.caption: The book itself. Roughly the size of two open hands.
Worked on by lamplight, one page at a time.
